summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a circular and proxy card for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for 24 August 2026 in London. The filing provides notice and logistical details for the EGM, including record date of 10 July 2026 and voting procedures via poll or proxy. The specific proposals to be voted on are not described in the excerpt, and there is no indication of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice, and the registrant is acting solely as the filer.
